# Design and dependencies

Why Waybar is built the way it is, what it needs from other ACO components, which libraries it uses and which versions it was tested with.

## Why it is built this way

- The bar shows **only what is permanent**: workspaces, clock, volume, battery, power. Launching programs and switching windows live on shortcuts and in the Fuzzel menu.
- It attaches to the compositor through the Hyprland IPC (`hyprland/workspaces`) and uses Hyprland's scripts for the power actions.

## What this configuration needs from others

| Component | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [Hyprland](https://aco-hypr.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | Workspaces through the Hyprland IPC; the power menu calls `powermenu.sh`, `hyprlock` and `hyprctl` |

## Who needs this configuration

| Component | Why |
| --- | --- |
| [Hyprland](https://aco-hypr.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | Started with the session (`Super + Shift + B` reloads it) |

## Packages and libraries

From the `PKGBUILD` of this component; “Tested with” is the version installed on the development machine (Arch Linux, as of 2026-11-20).

| Package | Minimum | Tested with | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aco-arch-dotfiles-core` | ≥ 0.3.0 | 0.3.0.r64.g6f4e3d6c742b-64 | The `aco` command, activation and synchronisation |
| `waybar` | – | 0.16.0-1 | Status bar |
| `ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd` | – | 3.5.1-2 | Font with Nerd Font symbols (Waybar, Yazi, Neovim, terminals, GTK) |
| `wireplumber` | – | 0.5.19-1 | `wpctl` for the volume keys and the Waybar volume module |
| `hyprland` | – | 0.57.2-1 | Wayland compositor; the configuration is Lua (since 0.55) and needs at least 0.56 |
| `hyprlock` | – | 0.9.7-2 | Screen lock (`Super + L`, power menu) |

Optional:

- `networkmanager` – network module and nmtui
- `bluez-utils` – bluetooth module
- `power-profiles-daemon` – power-profiles module

## Notes

- `networkmanager`, `bluez-utils` and `power-profiles-daemon` are **optional**: the shipped `config.jsonc` has no module for them; install them when you add the matching module (see the [guide](guide)).
- The bar needs `hyprland` (workspace module, `hyprctl`) and `hyprlock` (power menu); it does not depend on the ACO Hyprland package because that package depends on the bar.

## Shared foundations

These rules apply to **every** ACO component:

- **One repository per component**, with its own `PKGBUILD` and CI. Each configuration can be installed, tested and developed on its own;
  after a push the central registry builds the signed package ([packaging overview](https://aco-arch-dotfiles.readthedocs.io/en/latest/arch-package/)).
- **Pacman is the only updater.** No git pull at runtime; `aco` only merges new defaults with your changes (`.pacnew`).
- **Your copy, not the package's.** `~/.config/<module>` points to `~/.local/share/arch-dotfiles/config/<module>/`; the package stays untouched in `/usr/share/arch-dotfiles/<module>/`.
- **One palette, one font:** Catppuccin Mocha and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font in every component so nothing falls out of style.
- **The core** `aco-arch-dotfiles-core` (the `aco` command, activation, backups, synchronisation) is a dependency of every package.
